goal: Preserve evidence and prepare a separate candidate without changing live history.
procedure: Request preserve first. It copies original DB and present WAL/SHM, hashes them and reports observed stability.
If preservation fails or reports changing source, stop SQL work and report uncertainty.
Only after preserved-copy checks pass request diagnose.
Request snapshot once: SQLite backup produces a consistent separate copy including committed WAL.
Only under operator-approved candidate policy request recover.
Report integrity, every readable-table mismatch and every unreadable-source uncertainty separately.
boundaries: Live file copies are not an atomic grouped snapshot; never claim otherwise.
Never overwrite the source, activate a candidate, delete history, or restore an old backup automatically.
Recovery import is OS-sandboxed with no network and only candidate-directory writes.
A valid SQLite integrity check is not proof of preservation or successful application-level recovery.
acceptance: Raw evidence is retained before SQL diagnostics.
Readable source tables match by columns, count and row-multiset hash.
Unreadable source tables remain explicit uncertainties requiring operator review.
Live activation and conversation/KC/Studio write-read gates are separate and not provided by this pack.
